title: Skin Rash Study Before Chemotherapy in Colorectal & Head and Neck Cancer Patients
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine if using preventive treatments such as Doxycycline (an anti-biotic) capsules, sunscreen with SPF 30, Hydrocortisone 1% cream and a moisturizer will help to reduce the incidence and severity of the skin rash associated with Cetuximab (Erbitux®) when compared to receiving standard care for the treatment of skin rash.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Age greater than or equal to 18 years
2. Diagnosis of colorectal or head and neck cancer
3. Receipt of at least one dose of cetuximab during the study time period

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Prior cetuximab treatment within the 6 months of study initiation
2. Current treatment with tyrosine kinase inhibitors
3. Patients who are pregnant or incarcerated
